notes.title: Update Notes Sept. 19th - Minor Update
notes.content:
Hello Divers!

I wanted to take a moment to thank you all for your support. It has been great to watch some of you play via stream and to receive such fantastic feedback. You are all helping shape Somnium with each update. In fact, this update is [u]entirely [/u]due to player recommendations and bug spotting.

[b]Periscope[/b]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/W7P8yVk.png[/img]
The most under-utilized tool is the electromagnetic vision on the diver suit. Many players would rather guess the creature than use this jarring tool. While the intent behind this evidence collection method was to be uncomfortable and disorienting, it's not good if it's not being used. 
Enter Periscope (thanks Suppe). The periscope allows you to use electromagnetic vision from within the sub. There are some constraints on the tool's mobility, but I am sure some neat strategies will come out of it.

[b]Bubble Players[/b]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/1IG9pzL.png[/img]
When playing multiplayer, if you were to die from an attack in the diver suit, you would be stuck inside the cameras on the ship until the round was over. Sitting in a camera while your friends run aroundis no fun. I received multiple requests for some kind of ghost form for dead players to at least walk around on the sub.
Ghost forms don't really fit the theme here.... but maybe bubbles do?

[b]Bug Fixes[/b]
[list]
[*]Lingering Divers post-end game have been removed

[*]Blur hunting at end game has been resolved

[*]Various customization adjustments

[*]All custom items now appear in multiplayer

[*]Perk adjustments - Tuning Fork is more reliable

[*]Tutorial Adjustments

[/list]

notes.title: Major Content Update 1
notes.content:
[b]First Content Update:[/b]
A perk menu and [u]12 new perks[/u] have been added to the customization screen. Many of these perks help players specialize in certain roles on their team. Perks range from increased swim speed to refined electromagnetic vision. There is a perk that will make artifacts more visible and even a perk that enables big head mode... that one is the best, obviously. 

[b]This patch also includes:[/b]
[list]
[*][u]Persistent Lobbies[/u] for getting right back into the water!
[*]Quality of Life improvements
[*]Improved Localization and new font packs
[*]Local Optimization
[*]Network Optimization
[*]New Intro Song by [u]Junk Daye[/u]
[*]Bug fixes
[*]...and MUCH more.
[/list]

Check out the YouTube video for more information and let me know if there's something you'd like to see in the next content update. Thanks again for all the support. Go unlock all the perks. 

[b]Oh and someone send me a screenshot of a 5-person team with 5 Big Head Mode Perks... the effect stacks for each player with the perk... I don't think it will break the game. [/b]*shrug*

[previewyoutube=llLPHuK2Zrw;full][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: Hotfix #1 - 7/4/24
notes.content:
Thanks so much for a fantastic launch! I have loved watching some of you play and hearing feedback from all over world! Some of that feedback is reflected in this patch!

- Fixed Log UI
- Fixed Tutorial Arrows
- Fixed Tutorial UI
- Updated Tutorial Log Logic
- Updated Map readability
- Updated Sonar clarity
- Various bug fixes to camera and sub movement

Stay tuned for the first MAJOR content update coming in a few weeks. If you are struggling with Lovecraftian difficulty, this update is here to help!! Also, it will include Big Head Mode, because why not?
